description: Unofficial Gandalf the Grey fan art inspired by The Lord of the Rings. A fully robed, compact illustrated wizard tests a gentle staff glow, raises a small cup, tends a tiny plant and adjusts his pointed hat. Original nine-state choreography includes visible alternating boot strides and a soft landing; simplified robe and paper-leaf magic, no pipe or sword, and no official endorsement.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
